houses.name: Elmwood
houses.motto: Strength is gentleness that refuses to surrender.
houses.history: Founded by healers and patient teachers, Elmwood became a refuge for students who believed knowledge should protect the vulnerable. Its members value steady courage, loyalty and practical kindness.
houses.room: A warm common room overlooking an old courtyard tree, with plants, reading alcoves and a broad hearth.

houses.name: Embercrest
houses.history: Founded by explorers who led the academy's earliest expeditions, Embercrest prizes initiative and brave action. Its traditions teach that courage must be guided by responsibility.
houses.room: A bright upper hall with a practice balcony, trophy gallery and a long red-gold table.

houses.name: Starfall
houses.history: Born from astronomers and inventors, Starfall values curiosity and imagination. Its students keep unanswered questions as carefully as discoveries.
houses.room: A high observatory lounge with curved windows, star charts and quiet study desks.

houses.name: Thornkeep
houses.motto: What is worth doing is worth doing well.
houses.history: Established by guardians and craftspeople who maintained the academy through uncertain times, Thornkeep prizes preparation, patience and keeping one's word.
houses.room: A calm stone room beside the gardens, with a workshop corner, chess tables and a library ladder.

episodes.title: Day 001 · The Letter That Changed Everything
episodes.opening: The envelope arrives on an ordinary afternoon. Nithish reads the admission letter twice, then a third time. Aurelion Institute of Arcane Studies has accepted him. The two non-magical guardians who raised him try to hide how emotional they are. He packs late into the night, unsure what kind of person he will become there.
episodes.middle: At the academy gates, the towers rise behind a busy modern campus. Students cross the courtyard with floating cases and glowing notebooks. A cheerful student named Adrian notices Nithish studying the map upside down and offers to help. The first bell rings before either has found the right building.
episodes.closing: At the Elmwood welcome hall, Nithish is asked to place his hand on an old silver-leaf emblem. The leaves brighten gently. Somewhere in the Ministry, an old record is quietly reopened.
episodes.dailyMission: Complete a small piece of work you have been postponing.

choices.text: Accept Adrian's help and introduce yourself properly.
Thank him, then ask about the academy map and its strange markings.

Nithish is thinking about nithish arrives, joins elmwood and begins to find his place. when he notices a tool warm after everyone has left near the observatory steps. It seems like a small thing, but the timing makes him pause.
episodes.middle: Later, near the courtyard fountain, the moment becomes harder to ignore. There is a spell that refuses to settle, and a classmate has noticed it too. Nithish is thinking about final assessments bring the year's threads together. when he notices a drawer sealed with blue wax near the riverside path. It seems like a small thing, but the timing makes him pause.
episodes.middle: Later, near the duelling studio, the moment becomes harder to ignore. There is a tool warm after everyone has left, and a classmate has noticed it too. The group does not have the whole story, and nobody wants to jump to a conclusion. There are still lessons to attend, work to finish and people who deserve an honest answer.
episodes.closing: By evening, Nithish understands that a day does not need to be extraordinary to matter. Someone remembers the way he handled the moment. Tomorrow will bring another part of the story, but tonight he has one decision to make.
episodes.dailyMission: Complete a small piece of work you have been postponing.

choices.text: Quietly repair what you can with patience (Choice A · Day 360)

episodes.title: Day 365 · The Last Light of the First Year
episodes.opening: Winter settles over Aurelion. The final assessment is finished, the house banners hang above the courtyard and the friends who once barely knew one another now share a year of memories. Nithish thinks about the student who arrived at the gates with a folded map and no idea where to go.
episodes.middle: The academy celebration is warm and bright. Adrian makes a speech that goes on too long. Mira laughs, Kieran offers a sincere congratulations, Elara gathers everyone for a photograph and Rowan watches the snow gather on the old library roof. Nithish understands how much he has changed, not because he has become perfect, but because he has learned to keep going.
episodes.closing: Far from the academy, a Ministry clerk opens a sealed file connected to the old investigation. A new page has been added. It carries Nithish's name. At Aurelion, the last lantern goes out. The first year is over; the larger story is not.
episodes.dailyMission: Ask a useful question when you do not understand.

choices.text: Spend the final evening with the friends who made the year feel like home.
Visit the quiet courtyard and write down what you want the next year to become.

episodes.cliffhanger: The first year ends beneath winter lights. A sealed Ministry file is opened far away. Nithish's name is on its first page. The larger story has only begun.
